After you enable reception, opening the app automatically reconnects to nearby devices using the same transport. Reception continues across screens. Stop here or from the notification to turn off automatic reception. Relay starts off each time.

Public history stays in this app process only, up to 200 messages; the oldest are removed at the limit. Changing pages, rotating, stopping or restarting Mesh keeps it. Exiting or losing the process, or restarting after an in-place update, loses it. Message expiry does not delete displayed history, and visible history does not mean forwarding continues. Private chat history follows its own rules.
Public Mesh needs Android 10 or later, an arm64 system and a 64-bit app process.

Bluetooth connects compatible phones and Windows. When a computer first searches, tap “Let computers discover” and allow the system discoverability prompt.
Wi-Fi Aware requires compatible hardware on both devices using the same mode. It is not ordinary Wi-Fi or a hotspot. This path still needs its own hardware validation.
